text:
sophie: getting reports that IncidentBot didn't page oncall for ny-cluster errors around 10:02 UTC. multiple alerts in SRE -> no pages. anyone seeing paging failures?

devon: seeing 502/503 spikes from infer-notify-proxy, alert counts up. confirm no outbound pages sent in the notify logs. :frowning: 

opsbot: incidentbot: webhook delivery failed for route `page-oncall` (status=502) x3, queued -> backoff triggered.

devon: quick check: logs show retries dropped due to queue TTL exhaustion. also noticed the X-Oncall header is being truncated to ~128 chars in the proxy logs.

liam: I rolled the auth-proxy at 09:58 for a header-sanitizer change (shorten header max to 128 to mitigate some client abuse). rolling update went to all envs.

sophie: ah. incidentbot embeds oncall metadata in X-Oncall (long rotation payload). truncation would make signature mismatch and cause webhook to reject?

devon: reproducing locally:
```
$ curl -v -H "X-Oncall: rota=eng-sre;users=[sophie,anya,liam];meta=long-string..." http://notify.internal/v1/webhook
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
> Server: notify-proxy
> 
{"error":"invalid oncall header: truncated"}
```

anya-cs: we just had two enterprise customers open support tickets saying they never received pages for an alert. they're escalated to P2. I'm on the thread with them.

sophie: immediate mitigation: devon, can you disable the header-sanitizer change and re-deploy proxy to restore full header size? if not, we should enable manual SMS fallback for affected rotations.

liam: rolling back the sanitizer now. egress a hotfix to restore header max=8k. will push in ~2 mins.

opsbot: deploy started for auth-proxy @ 10:18 UTC (liam).

incidentbot: queued 18 suppressed pages for route `page-oncall` due to delivery failures. manual retry recommended.

devon: re-run the queued deliveries after rollback. I can trigger replay via `notify-admin replay --route page-oncall --since 10:00`

sophie: doing manual SMS pages to oncall rotation for the ones with customer impact now. @anya-cs please update customers that we're actively remediating and sent manual pages.

anya-cs: updated both customers, sent temporary pager SMS at 10:23 UTC. they're acknowledging now.

devon: replay started. clip from replay tool:
```
Replaying 18 messages...
15 delivered, 3 failed -> retrying
All delivered by 10:26 UTC
```

liam: rollback complete. auth-proxy now accepting full X-Oncall headers.

sophie: root cause (prelim): header-sanitizer deploy truncated X-Oncall, causing notify-proxy to reject webhook requests and queue TTL to expire -> incidentbot suppressed pages. impact: 2 enterprise customer pages missed; internal oncall missed ~18 pages but we initiated manual SMS fallback.

devon: mitigation steps: 1) rollback header-sanitizer (done) 2) drain and replay queued deliveries (done) 3) increase observability on header reject rate and queue TTL saturation 4) add a safety: when incidentbot sees N consecutive webhook rejects for a route, escalate via SMS fallback automatically.

sophie: filing a postmortem. owners: liam (deploy change), devon (notify replay & observability), anya-cs (customer comms). severity: P2.

liam: sorry for the break, will add e2e test for long X-Oncall header in the deploy pipeline. :white_check_mark: 

opsbot: incident closed (manual mitigation completed) @ 10:35 UTC.

sophie: thanks everyone. please add any extra notes to the PM. :eyes:
